entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. This call may be recorded for quality assurance. How may I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return a VeloBand Pulse I bought. It's not working how I expected and I need my money back.
Certainly. I can help you with that. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with the purchase, please?
Thank you. One moment while I pull up your order. Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse here. When was it purchased?
Uh, I think it was about two weeks ago. Maybe a little less.
I see the purchase date was August 1st, and today is August 16th. I am sorry, but our return window for the VeloBand Pulse is 10 days. Unfortunately, we cannot process a full refund at this point.
What?! Ten days? That's ridiculous! I need this money back. This thing is practically brand new! I can't believe this! I want to speak to your manager! This is terrible customer service.

I understand your frustration, sir. While I can't offer a full refund due to being outside the return window, which is stated in our return policy, I can offer you store credit for the full purchase amount. This credit can be used on any product at VeloFit. How does that sound?
Store credit? Seriously? I wanted my money back! This is unbelievable. I am really not happy about this.

I understand, and I apologize for the inconvenience. While I can’t make a policy exception for a full refund since it's been over 10 days, the store credit will allow you to try another VeloFit product that might be a better fit. Perhaps you'd like a different model, or apparel. Would you like me to apply the store credit to your account?
Ugh, fine. I guess so. But I better be able to use it on anything.

Absolutely. The store credit can be used on any item on our website or in our stores. I've just applied the credit to your account. You should receive an email confirmation shortly. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
So, I can use it on anything at all? Even like, new running shoes?
Yes, that's correct. Anything currently in stock at VeloFit.
Okay, okay. Well, thanks for finally sorting something out. I appreciate it.
You're very welcome! I'm glad we could find a solution. Have a great day!
